$comment: Every source records url, version, retrieval date, license and the attribution text that must ship with anything derived from it. The pipeline FAILS if any license field is empty. Attribution here is a legal obligation, not a nicety: several sources are ODbL with share-alike.

sources.note: Carries the 33 FCLASS_* point-of-view fields. This is the working source for the perspective mechanic today; Overture division_boundary carries an equivalent `perspectives` property but as of early 2026 the schema existed while the data was sparse. Check before migrating.

sources.note: GOTCHA: Marine Regions' EEZ polygons INCLUDE archipelagic, internal and territorial waters — a deliberate deviation from UNCLOS. Difference the inner zones out before rendering, or the inner zones draw four deep. Requires a form submission, so it is not fetched automatically.

sources.note: Filter at the query, not after: subtype='road' AND class IN ('motorway','trunk','primary'). 300M+ segments unfiltered.

rejected.reason: Prohibits commercial use. Cabinet has a paid tier, so this is disqualifying regardless of data quality. Widely recommended and widely misused.
56,600 features globally of which 25,766 (45%) have type='Unknown', and coverage is heavily skewed to North America and Europe. Acceptable only as a decorative low-zoom hint, never as a road network.
License reported inconsistently across mirrors — ODbL (FAO), CC-0 (GLOBIO), CC BY 4.0 (Earth Engine catalog). Verify at globio.info before shipping and assume ODbL if unresolved.
